title: AI Leaders Are Calling for a Slowdown. Trump’s Team Says It’s on Them
summary: Sam Altman and Elon Musk backed Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei’s weekend plea for regulation. The White House seems unlikely to oblige.
reason: Media coverage of debate over AI regulation: AI leaders' calls for a slowdown and the White House's likely stance. No concrete official action, rule, or enforcement event, and no primary artifact, so R4 (which excludes opinion/commentary) and other rules do not apply.
